Ruth (Support): Escalating 'Northfield' trial. SSO OK but embed ingest 403 after auth. Customer mentioned they may need on-prem/dedicated for compliance; renewal discussion in 6 days. Marking as priority. :rotating_light:
Diego (CS): Acknowledged. Paste repro + any logs and customer contact preference. I'll draft a comms plan focused on both short-term unblock and longer-term deployment options.
Ruth (Support): Repro (prod + staging):
```
GET /auth/okta/callback 302 -> /app
POST /embed/ingest 403 {"error":"forbidden","reason":"tenant_not_mapped"}
```
Ruth (Support): Account: northfield-trial, region=us-east-1, SSO=Okta. Tried cache clear, key rotate. No change.
Anya (Eng): Looking now. Saw recent tenant-routing tweak earlier today. Pulling mapping logs. :mag_right:
Marco (Solutions): For comms: (1) immediate ack + 20m ETA; (2) provide manual mapping steps as workaround; (3) offer quick enablement call + optional private deployment discussion with Solutions+Sales; (4) flag renewal as "pending architecture decision" until remediation and session. I'll draft language.
Diego (CS): Good. Ruth  who is the account owner and timezone so I can schedule the handoff?
Ruth (Support): Owner is @harry.northfield, CET. I scheduled a brief sync at 15:00 CET and DM'd him. I also noted he asked about on-prem options.
Anya (Eng): Found regression in tenant-router when tenant names include numbers + dash. Hotfix branch created, running tests (~10m).
infra-bot: deploy-start tenant-router-hotfix-598765 5987654400
Marco (Solutions): I'll include the manual mapping KB link in the customer note: https://redwood.internal/kb/tenant-router#manual-map and an outline of on-prem/dedicated next steps (discovery call + compliance checklist).
infra-bot: deploy-succeeded tenant-router-hotfix-598765 5987654482
Anya (Eng): Post-deploy verification: repro passes for northfield-trial; embed ingest returns 200 in smoke tests.
Diego (CS): I'll tell @harry.northfield we have a fix and offer the enablement + architecture discussion. For renewal: temporarily remove "at-risk" after session and update based on outcome.
Ruth (Support): Closing the support ticket; forwarding follow-ups to CS: enablement invite, arch/discovery for on-prem option, post-call summary.
Marco (Solutions): I'll schedule a joint call with Sales if they want to evaluate dedicated/on-prem. I'll also attach a short feedback survey to capture urgency/concerns for the renewal team.
Diego (CS): Assigning follow-ups: 1) Enablement session owner: Marco; 2) Customer-facing summary + technical notes: Anya + Ruth; 3) Renewal architecture review: Diego. Adding CRM note and a 7-day follow-up reminder. :white_check_mark:
Ruth (Support): Thanks all  smooth cross-team handling.
Diego (CS): Closing thread for support; CS will run the comms plan and capture feedback during the enablement/discovery call.
